description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a compassionate leader who can drive clinical excellence and maintain regulatory compliance.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
